page.layout: Running head across the top: title "Kalendarium Julianum." with page number 161 at right; below it the sub-heading "JANUARIUS."; then one table of calendar columns: Aurei numi | Dies mensis | Litera | (unlabelled Roman-numeral date column) | Dies collecti in anno, split into communi and bissextili. Below the table, the catchword-like line "FEBRU." at right, with "Y" at left.

main_text.head: JANUARIUS.
main_text.l: Aurei numi | Dies mensis | Litera | | Dies collecti in anno: communi | bissextili

page.notes: Printed table; the Aurei numi column, handwritten-looking marks and stains are ignored. The first column header is "Aurei numi" and the second "Dies mensis" in italic. Numbers in the Aurei column are printed in bold for some rows; no other marginal text. The bottom line "Y" and "FEBRU." belong to the next month's heading. Exact numerals in the Aurei column may be imperfectly read.
